concepts.definition: Country component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.country_code), as published and lower-cased (e.g. 'au', 'us', 'cn'). It is frequently blank, and a blank must not be read as an Australian address or as absence of a country. It is a party-record address attribute, not a statement of the party's place of incorporation or of the business's registered office.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.country is owned by business and describes the business's own stated address; this value is an unverified, often-missing address attribute of an IP-office party record, so reuse would change owner and meaning.

concepts.definition: State or province component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.state_code), as published and lower-cased (e.g. 'nsw', 'vic'). Values are not restricted to Australian states and are frequently blank; it is a party-record address attribute, not a business operating region or a statement of incorporation.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.state is owned by business, is an enum of Australian/NZ/OTHER codes and describes the business's own address; this raw, lower-cased, non-Australian-only party-record value has a different owner and scope, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Post code component of the address recorded for the party on the IP right application record (party_activity.post_code), kept as the raw published string because formats are not uniform (e.g. '2106' vs 'gu14 0lx'). It is a party-record address attribute and is not normalised to an Australian postcode.
concepts.why_not_existing: address.postcode is owned by business and describes the business's own address; this unnormalised, mixed-format party-record value has a different owner and no guaranteed Australian scope, so reuse would change meaning.

reuse.dyn.party.party_key: Party key on the same party-role record; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party.party_name: Party name on the same party-role record; unchanged.
reuse.dyn.party.abn_supplied: ABN as supplied on the party record; unchanged.
